scope: Full native movement sequence rendered locally before GPU; independent full decode, 16 programme-time visual samples, object/camera animation and sound envelope review. No founder creative approval or audio listening claim.
story: One active stroke motivates the timeline and card grid; the grid unfolds into a dimensional ribbon; the ring becomes a layered horizon; that light contracts into a monogram and wordmark.

checks.real3DWow: A straight component/timeline unfolds into a polished twisting loop, surrounded by moving rails and perspective cards.
checks.soundEscalation: One musical motif, progressive harmony/rhythm, structural rises and a single final hit; measured stereo peak/RMS without clipping.

limitations: 480x270 / 12fps native proxy source, encoded at 640x360 / 24fps for shared-worker compatibility; final is full 1920x1080 / 24fps native frames.
Low-sample proxy denoising softens small UI text; final uses 24 OptiX samples.
Optional narration remains on-screen text with separate insertion windows.
